title: Polynomial Compressibility and Forbidden Oriented Forests
summary: For a nonempty acyclic oriented graph $H$, let $p(H)$ be the order of a longest directed path and let $τ(H)$ be the least positive integer $n$ such that $H$ admits a homomorphism to every tournament of order $n$. For all $p\ge3$ and $g\ge1$, we construct a connected acyclic oriented graph $H$ with underlying girth greater than $g$, absolute and relative oriented clique numbers equal to three, and \[ p(H)=p,\qquad τ(H)=r_{\mathrm{tr}}(p), \] where $r_{\mathrm{tr}}(p)=2^{Θ(p)}$ is the tournament Ramsey number for a transitive $p$-vertex tournament.
